note: First election of Moira Rural District Council, 6 April 1899: the County Down electoral divisions of Lurgan Poor Law Union, reported with the union's other divisions under the heading "Lurgan Rural District Council". No party labels printed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Donacloney' to Donaghcloney (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Moira Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Donaghcloney; the rounds were filed as Donacloney (1899, 1927, 1930, 1936, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1967); Donaghcloney (1924, 1933, 1964). This round was filed as 'Donacloney', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (donacloney) answers with a redirect to this one.
